Interface Observable<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the type of the value
All Known Subinterfaces:
Property<T>
public interface Observable<T>
A value that tells its listeners when it changes.

Listeners are called synchronously, on the thread that changed the value, only when the value changes (Objects.equals(Object, Object)). Core has no EDT: the UI layer moves its work to the EDT itself.

map(Function) and combine(Observable, Observable, BiFunction) are lazy: a mapped observable subscribes to its sources only while it has subscribers. While it has some, it keeps its last value and notifies them only when a source change gives a new value; its get() returns that value. Without subscribers, get() computes from the sources' current values. Mapping functions may therefore run more than once, on any thread: they must be cheap and free of side effects.
